premise: Woodpecker drums and drums, and Acorn and Pinecone wonder who he's talking to — until, far away, another drum answers.
inspiration: The echo motif of folk tales (the voice that calls back from far away), turned: the answer isn't an echo but a real friend.
lesson: Keep calling out; a friend may be listening.

en-US.title: Woodpecker Drums Hello
en-US.text: [excited] {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Woodpecker clung to the bark of the big tree {woodpecker:live} {sfx:drum} and drummed. Rat-a-tat-TAT! Along walked little {acorn:enter} Acorn, and {pinecone:enter} Pinecone came rolling after her. {acorn:face surprised} [curious] Who are you talking to? asked Acorn. {woodpecker:face sad} A friend I haven't met yet, said Woodpecker. Somewhere far away. He {woodpecker:live hold} drummed again, and listened. [whispers] Nothing. {pinecone:face sad} Nothing at all. {acorn:face sad} Acorn wanted to help. So she {acorn:live hold} closed her eyes tight and wished. And Pinecone {pinecone:live} opened all her scales, as if every one of them could listen. {sfx:far-drum solo} Far, far away, someone drummed back! {acorn:live resume} Acorn's eyes popped open. {pinecone:face surprised} [gasps] Did you hear that? {woodpecker:live resume} Woodpecker tapped back, and chirped. {woodpecker:face happy} Rat-a-tat. Hello! Rat-a-tat, said the drum far away. Hello, hello! {acorn:face happy} {acorn:hop x2} {pinecone:face happy} {pinecone:hop x2} Acorn and Pinecone bounced for joy. [happily] A brand-new friend… and they hadn't even met yet.

es-ES.title: Carpintero toca: ¡hola!
es-ES.text: [excited] {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Pájaro carpintero se agarró a la corteza del árbol grande {woodpecker:live} {sfx:drum} y tamborileó. ¡Ra-ta-ta-TÁ! Por allí llegó andando la pequeña {acorn:enter} Bellota, y detrás, rodando, {pinecone:enter} Piña. {acorn:face surprised} [curious] ¿Con quién hablas? preguntó Bellota. {woodpecker:face sad} Con un amigo al que aún no conozco, dijo Carpintero. Uno que vive lejos. {woodpecker:live hold} Tamborileó otra vez, y escuchó. [whispers] Nada. {pinecone:face sad} Nada de nada. {acorn:face sad} Bellota quería ayudar. Así que {acorn:live hold} cerró los ojos muy fuerte y pidió un deseo. Y Piña {pinecone:live} abrió todas sus escamas, como si cada una pudiera escuchar. {sfx:far-drum solo} ¡A lo lejos, muy lejos, alguien contestó! {acorn:live resume} Bellota abrió los ojos. {pinecone:face surprised} [gasps] ¿Lo habéis oído? {woodpecker:live resume} Carpintero contestó con un toque y un pío. {woodpecker:face happy} Ra-ta-tá: ¡hola! Ra-ta-tá, dijo el tambor lejano: ¡hola, hola! {acorn:face happy} {acorn:hop x2} {pinecone:face happy} {pinecone:hop x2} Bellota y Piña dieron saltos de alegría. [happily] Un amigo nuevo… y todavía ni se conocían.
